episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Demon Justitia possesses the body of Judge Kang Bit-na and must punish criminals.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Da-on receives unexpected news while protecting Min-jeong. Bit-na's first infernal trial begins.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: While reveling in her string of executions, Bit-na encounters someone unexpected.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Bit-na's infernal trial begins once again for Bae Jayeong's misdeeds. "Bad adults must be punished."

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: While trailing Bit-na, Da-on finds himself at a secret demons' meeting. A horrific incident occurs.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: "Why do you keep interfering?" Will Bit-na escape Da-on and conclude her infernal trial?

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: So-young suspects serial killer J is back. Meanwhile, Da-on remains suspicious about Bit-na's identity.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: So-young disappears. Bit-na worries for Da-on but concludes Choi Won-joong's infernal trial as a demon.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Da-on vows revenge against serial killer J and joins forces with demon Bit-na.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Detective J's true identity is uncovered. Bit-na encounters emotions she's never wanted to face.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Bit-na loses her powers for breaking the rules but still heads to Jae-geol's home to uncover J.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: A body is found in a burned car, and the truth is revealed. Who is J?

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Finally, J's trial begins. At a crossroads, Bit-na must make a life-or-death choice.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: J commits another evil act after escaping, and Bit-na is dragged to Hell. Will this be the end?
